description: This file defines the 'Middleware' class in the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides static methods to create various middleware components used in request handling, such as source file handling, validation, request building, signing, retries, diagnostics, and request/response mapping. These middlewares are used to modify, validate, sign, or track AWS service commands and requests within the SDK's internal request pipeline.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: A final class that provides static methods to generate middleware functions used throughout the AWS SDK for PHP for handling request modifications, validation, signing, retries, and diagnostics.

methods.name: sourceFile
methods.description: Creates middleware that replaces a command's source parameter with a LazyOpenStream from a file path, enabling upload of source files.

methods.name: validation
methods.description: Creates middleware that validates command input against the service model before request dispatch.

methods.name: requestBuilder
methods.description: Creates middleware to serialize commands into HTTP requests using a provided serializer function and optionally handle endpoints.

methods.name: signer
methods.description: Creates middleware that signs requests with AWS credentials, supporting special signers like TokenAuthorization or S3ExpressSignature.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware that invokes a callback for debugging or logging, then proceeds with the request chain.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Creates middleware that implements request retry logic with customizable decider and delay functions.

methods.name: invocationId
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds a unique invocation ID header to requests for tracking in Lambda environments.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds a Content-Type header based on the request URI's filename extension for applicable operations.

methods.name: recursionDetection
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds a trace ID header to requests in Lambda environments to prevent recursive invocation issues.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Creates middleware that records command and request history for testing or debugging.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation function to each request passing through.

methods.name: mapCommand
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation to commands before passing them along.

methods.name: mapResult
methods.description: Creates middleware that transforms the result of a command execution.

methods.name: timer
methods.description: Creates middleware that times request duration, attaching timing info to the result or error.
